title: File:An ancient landscape for modern astronomy.tif
desc: Tile 107, or “the Outlier” as it is known, is one of 128 original tiles of the Murchison Widefield Array radio telescope located in the remote outback of Western Australia. This image was taken at night with a 30 second exposure — lighting the ancient landscape is the Moon. Credit: Pete Wheeler.
